agent._note: --strict-mcp-config + empty --mcp-config keeps claude.ai MCP connectors out: they attach mid-conversation (33 tools, ~50 KB of JSON) at a different request each run, which rewrites the cached prefix and makes cache write / context noisy. --no-session-persistence keeps bench runs out of ~/.claude/projects. DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1: a bench run once triggered `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, which swaps the binary mid-bench and makes every following spawn fail with ENOENT.

tasks.prompt: The test suite is failing. Run `npm test`, find the bug in src/ and fix it. Do not modify the tests.

check.cmd: node --test >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -q 'total of a single item' test/cart.test.js

tasks._note: Control task: the agent filters the test output itself (npm test | head -50, | grep '^# (pass|fail)'), so nothing reaches 2 KB and the proxy has nothing to compress. Unfiltered, Node 20's TAP output is ~13 KB and would be cut ~80%.

tasks.prompt: A payment failed this morning. Look at logs/server.log and tell me which order failed and why. Start your reply with the order id.
Run `node scripts/metrics.js` and tell me which host looks overloaded on CPU. Reply with the host name.
Print data/requests.csv with a shell command and tell me which request has an abnormal latency. Reply with its request_id.
Explain how src/cart.js works and list the edge cases it handles badly.
Create a simple landing page in public/index.html for a coffee shop: header, three sections and a contact form. Plain HTML and CSS, no framework.
tasks._note: The user's example: a trivial from-scratch task that a frontier model would do at frontier prices. Any rung handles it.

tasks.prompt: Add an order history: src/orders.js that saves orders to data/orders.json, a scripts/order.js CLI that adds an order from its arguments, and tests for both. Do not touch src/cart.js or its tests.

check.cmd: test -f src/orders.js && test -f scripts/order.js && ls test | grep -qi order && node --test test/*order*.test.* >/dev/null 2>&1

tasks._note: A well-defined multi-file feature (the router's build rung). The pre-existing cart bug is excluded from the check on purpose.

_rung_note: Tasks cover the router's rungs: html-page / log-needle / metrics-json / csv-outlier / explain are lookup, fix-bug is edit, order-history is build. Run with the model a user would pick by hand (--model fable or opus) so passthrough is what they pay without the proxy.
